text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Arrrgh! Seriously, WHAT DA HELL! I
can't take it
anymore!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
What is Brian's DEAL? If she's gonna eat
so much,
the cafeteria needs to start
limitin' people!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
And please! Somebody stop Rudolf and
her
crimes against comedy!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... But no one else is makin' wise cracks... Am I the weird one?
